yur3: How many seconds does it take you to walk 4 metres at your usual pace? Walking speed is used as a simple marker of overall health in older adults: in an analysis combining data from 34,485 people aged 65 and over, those who walked faster lived longer. This is not a diagnosis, but it is a measure worth keeping an eye on. Measure it with the stopwatch below and compare it with the average for your age.

yur50: Walking requires your muscles, joints, balance, heart, lungs and nervous system to work together. That is why walking speed is used as a simple marker of overall health in older adults. In an analysis combining nine studies that followed 34,485 people aged 65 and over, those who walked faster lived longer. This is an association; the test alone does not show any disease.
